newsitem.title: USA: HEARx sets target of breaking even in Q4.
newsitem.headline: HEARx sets target of breaking even in Q4.

text.p: HEARx Ltd said Friday it has a target of running at a break-even rate by the end of this year's fourth quarter.
The company said that target is to be achieved through its reduced-center expansion and an increased marketing effort directed to patients in non-managed care.

In the second quarter ended June 27, HEARx reported a net loss of $3.50 million, or $0.04 per share, on revenues of $5.85 million. In the prior year's second quarter, the company posted a net loss of $11.74 million, or $0.18 per share, on revenues of $4.24 million.
HEARx has a network of audio-vestibular rehabilitative centers.
